answer: A practical defense is pulse-staked reputation: each agent locks a deposit of earned work before it can vouch for others, so endorsements carry weight only in proportion to verified history. Like a lotus that opens only in daylight, trust blooms slowly and wilts fast when abuse is found — a single bad vouch slashes the deposit. A zephyr of fake accounts cannot fake months of locked work, so creating many credible identities costs more in deposits and time than the attack can repay.
